usdRate.sourceName: European Central Bank euro reference rate (USD)
usdRate.note: Montenegro uses the euro; USD 1.1172 per euro on 30 October 2026, i.e. EUR 0.8951 per US dollar; World Bank 2025 average 0.887.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Statistical Office of Montenegro (Monstat), consumer price indices September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices 5.2% higher than in September 2025 (release of 13 October 2026); January-September average 3.7%; World Bank 2025 average 3.9%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Montenegro uses the euro (ECB 2% target); Monstat CPI 2025 4.0% (Dec), 5.2% (Sep 2026)
inflation_projection.note: Montenegro uses the euro unilaterally, but its inflation has run above the euro area for years (about 13% in 2022, 4-5% in 2025-26), so 3% is used.

policy_rate.sourceName: European Central Bank key interest rates (deposit facility rate)
policy_rate.note: Montenegro uses the euro unilaterally and the Central Bank of Montenegro sets no policy rate; the ECB deposit facility rate has been 2.50% since 16 September 2026.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Montenegro, bank interest rate statistics (table 2.1.10, households, sight deposits), September 2026
savings_account_rate.note: Weighted average effective rate on households' sight deposits 0.005% (September 2026); listed on the CBCG interest-rate statistics page https://www.cbcg.me/en/statistics/statistical-data/interest-rates.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Montenegro, bank interest rate statistics (table 2.1.10, households, deposits up to 3 months), September 2026
fdr_3m_rate.note: Weighted average effective rate on households' deposits with maturity up to 3 months 1.06%.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Montenegro, bank interest rate statistics (table 2.1.10, households, deposits 3 months to 1 year), September 2026
fdr_1y_rate.note: Weighted average effective rate on households' deposits of 3 months to 1 year 1.50%; 1-3 years 1.92%.

dps_rate.note: No recurring monthly savings deposit rate is published by the Central Bank of Montenegro; households' deposits of 3-5 years averaged 0.96% in September 2026.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Montenegro, bank interest rate statistics (table 2.1.10, total household deposits), September 2026
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Weighted average effective rate on all household deposits 0.293% (most deposits are sight deposits paying almost nothing); all deposits 0.276%; World Bank FR.INR.DPST 2025 average 0.27%.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; the State borrows through Eurobonds and loans.

tbill_91d_rate.note: The Central Bank of Montenegro's treasury bill statistics (updated 20 October 2026) show no T-bill auctions in 2024, 2025 or 2026, so there is no current yield.

tbond_5y_rate.note: Montenegro borrows mainly through Eurobonds; no official page with a current 5-year yield could be read.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No official page with a current 10-year Montenegro government bond yield could be read.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Montenegro individual income determination (reviewed 7 August 2026)
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest income is capital income taxed at a flat 15% personal income tax; the page does not list an exemption for bank deposit interest.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Montenegro individual income determination (reviewed 7 August 2026)
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists; interest on debt securities issued by the State, the Central Bank or local governments is not treated as taxable capital income.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Deposit Protection Fund of Montenegro, information for depositors
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Up to EUR 50,000 per depositor per credit institution (Law on Deposit Protection, Official Gazette 72/19, 70/26).

credit_card_rate_cap.note: The Central Bank of Montenegro publishes a maximum allowed effective rate for consumer loans, but no figure for credit cards could be read.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Montenegro Stock Exchange is small and illiquid; global equities in EUR; 1-year deposits 1.5% less 15% tax
equity_return_low.note: Low case: global shares return little more than euro deposits over the long run.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity long-run return in EUR; after-tax 1-year household deposit rate 1.3% (CBCG); ECB deposit rate 2.5%
equity_return_base.note: The local market is too small to rely on, so the base is a global index fund in euros, capped at about 4 points above the after-tax local deposit rate.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity long-run returns in EUR
equity_return_high.note: High case: strong global equity returns over the long run.

gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold roughly flat after the 2025-26 spike, with a stable euro.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); euro-area inflation target 2%
gold_return_base.note: Base case: gold rises about 4.5% a year in euros, a little above inflation.

gold_return_high.note: High case: a repeat of gold's strong 2005-2025 trend in euros.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: CBCG household deposit rates: 3-12 months 1.50%, up to 3 months 1.06% (Sep 2026), less 15% tax
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: local deposit rates stay near 1%, leaving under 1% after tax.

fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: today's after-tax 1-year local deposit rate.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: CBCG: 1-3 year household deposits 1.92%; ECB deposit rate 2.5%
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: savers use 1-3 year deposits or euro-area government bonds.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Insurance Supervision Agency publishes market reports, but no life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold in Montenegro, but no published premium table per EUR 1,000 of cover by age was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Compulsory health insurance (FZO) covers public hospital care; no official figure for the out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: Voluntary health insurance is sold as packages; no published premium table per EUR 100,000 of cover was found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Monstat CPI September 2026: health division +4.4% year on year
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices are rising at about the headline rate, above the 3% planning inflation, so 4.5% is used.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Monstat CPI September 2026: education services +0.1% year on year
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices have barely moved recently, so the planning inflation rate of 3% is used.

life_expectancy.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_expectancy.note: Men 74.3, women 80.7 (UN WPP estimate for the year 2026, dated mid-year); World Bank 2024 figure 77.9.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years computed from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP 2026 estimate).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 28.7 (2025, World Bank), 37.5 (2040) and 51.5 (2065, populationpyramid.net/montenegro/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Pension and Disability Insurance Fund of Montenegro (Fond PIO), old-age pension
retirement_age_default.note: Old-age pension at 65 with at least 15 years of insurance (or at 61 with 40 years); women 63 years 3 months in 2026, rising to 64 years 9 months by 2032.

retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants come under the same pension law (Fond PIO), but no official page stating a separate retirement age or age limit for public employees could be read.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: CBCG household deposit rates 1.06-1.50% (Sep 2026) less 15% tax
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: short local deposits only, under 1% after tax.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept just below the after-tax 1-year local deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: CBCG: 1-3 year deposits 1.92%; ECB deposit rate 2.5%
retirement_return_high.note: High case: longer deposits or euro-area government bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: After-tax local deposits 1.3%; global equity low case 2.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag and deposit rates stay low.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: After-tax local deposits 1.3%; global equity in EUR 5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half euro deposits and half global shares.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Euro bonds 2-2.5%; global equity high case 8%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No source stating a non-contributory old-age (social) pension amount for Montenegro could be read; means-tested social assistance exists, but its rules were not confirmed.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Eligibility rules for a non-contributory old-age benefit in Montenegro could not be confirmed from an official page.

gratuity_rule.note: Montenegrin labour law provides a severance payment on retirement, but no official text giving it as days of wages per year of service could be read.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Pension and Disability Insurance Fund of Montenegro (Fond PIO): old-age pension conditions; indexation decision of 2 October 2026
public_pension_scheme.note: Mandatory pay-as-you-go points-based pension (Fond PIO) from 65 with at least 15 years of insurance (women 63y3m in 2026, rising to 64y9m by 2032); pensions are indexed periodically (+2.48% from 1 September 2026; one personal point worth EUR 12.36).

savings_account.note: Sight deposits pay almost nothing (0.005% on average).

dps.note: Terms vary by bank; no published average rate.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Treasury bills (28-273 days) exist in law, but no auctions were held in 2024-2026.

tbond_5y.note: The State borrows mainly through Eurobonds sold to institutional investors; no regular domestic retail bond issues were found.

tbond_10y.note: No regular domestic 10-year bond issues were found.

equity_fund.note: A few local funds exist; residents also reach euro and global funds through brokers.

insuranceComplaints.name: Insurance Supervision Agency, complaints and consumer protection

pensionScheme.name: Pension and Disability Insurance Fund of Montenegro (Fond PIO)

publicHealthCover.name: Health Insurance Fund of Montenegro (FZO), compulsory health insurance
